CGKY25, Lemma 9.1: Lemma 9.1 (KZG is function binding). Suppose the ARSDH assumption (Definition 9.5) holds with error [formula follows in source].

Paper-derived mathematical transcription (notation flattened from cached PDF text): If ARSDH has error epsilon_ARSDH(lambda,D,t_ARSDH), then KZG (Construction9.4) has function-binding error epsilon_FC(lambda,D+1,L,t_FC) <= epsilon_ARSDH(lambda,D,t_ARSDH), where t_ARSDH <= t_FC + 2 L^2 + L + D(L+8) + 2(D+1)^2. This is quantified over every security parameter lambda, polynomial degree bound D, number L of samples, and circuit-size bound t_FC. Function binding means accepting all openings to one commitment while no single permitted message/polynomial is consistent with every query/answer pair.

Paper-derived prerequisite transcription: Construction9.4 uses prime-order bilinear groups with generators, samples a private nonzero tau in Z_p, publishes [1]_1,...,[tau^D]_1,[1]_2,[tau]_2, commits as [p(tau)]_1 and checks e(cm-[beta]_1,[1]_2)=e(pf,[tau-alpha]_2). Definition9.5 bounds, for every size-bounded ARSDH circuit and permitted group tuple, the probability of producing (S,h1,h2) with |S|=D+1, h1 nonzero, and h2=(1/Z_S(tau))*h1, where Z_S(X)=product_{s in S}(X-s). The attacker receives the public SRS, not the trapdoor. Auxiliary input distributions are explicit in the proof of Lemma9.1. This transcription omits no intended resource bound: the circuit-size quantifiers and reduction cost above are part of the target.

scope: Independent source is cached paper text, with header 2025-05-27; exact ePrint PDF revision and byte hash remain unavailable. Lemma9.1 concerns ordinary KZG function binding, not state-restoration function binding of batched/linearized KZG or the full Plonk theorem. Cached Definition9.5 differs from the Lean citation number9.6. Paper degree <=D and Lean degree<n suggest n=D+1, but ARSDH cardinality/degree conventions require explicit review; do not silently identify n with D. Paper circuit-size bounds, auxiliary distribution, private tau and group-generator hypotheses must remain visible. Lean hp:p>=n+2 and pairing nondegeneracy are explicit formal qualifications; no claim that paper discharges every Lean qualification. Before version quantifies its hardness assumption over unrestricted Lean adversary functions; relation to the paper size-bounded circuit assumption is unresolved, and an overly strong/vacuous premise does not by itself make the conditional theorem false.
